mapper.select: SELECT course_id, current_revision FROM learning_event_origins WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND origin_kind = #{originKind} AND origin_id = #{originId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_event_origins (user_id, origin_kind, origin_id, course_id, current_revision) VALUES (#{userId}, #{originKind}, #{originId}, #{courseId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_revision = current_revision
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_event_origins SET current_revision = #{revision} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND origin_kind = #{originKind} AND origin_id = #{originId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO learning_events ( user_id, course_id, origin_kind, origin_id, origin_revision, output_no, actor, verb, object_kind, object_ref, object_from, object_to, topic_id, payload, evidence, confidence, claim_at, claim_seq, occurred_at ) VALUES
(#{e.userId}, #{e.courseId}, #{e.originKind}, #{e.originId}, #{e.originRevision}, #{e.outputNo}, #{e.actor}, #{e.verb}, #{e.objectKind}, #{e.objectRef}, #{e.objectFrom}, #{e.objectTo}, #{e.topicId}, #{e.payload}, #{e.evidence}, #{e.confidence}, #{e.claimAt}, #{e.claimSeq}, #{e.occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT e.* FROM learning_events e JOIN learning_event_origins o ON o.user_id = e.user_id AND o.origin_kind = e.origin_kind AND o.origin_id = e.origin_id AND o.current_revision = e.origin_revision WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.course_id = #{courseId} AND e.event_id > #{afterId} AND e.verb <> 'RETRACTED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM learning_events c JOIN learning_event_origins co ON co.user_id = c.user_id AND co.origin_kind = c.origin_kind AND co.origin_id = c.origin_id AND co.current_revision = c.origin_revision WHERE c.user_id = e.user_id AND c.course_id = e.course_id AND c.verb IN ('RETRACTED', 'SUPERSEDES') AND JSON_VALUE(c.payload, '$.target') = e.event_id) ORDER BY e.event_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.event_id, e.course_id, e.verb, (o.current_revision IS NOT NULL AND o.current_revision = e.origin_revision AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM learning_events c JOIN learning_event_origins co ON co.user_id = c.user_id AND co.origin_kind = c.origin_kind AND co.origin_id = c.origin_id AND co.current_revision = c.origin_revision WHERE c.user_id = e.user_id AND c.course_id = e.course_id AND c.verb IN ('RETRACTED', 'SUPERSEDES') AND JSON_VALUE(c.payload, '$.target') = e.event_id)) AS live FROM learning_events e LEFT JOIN learning_event_origins o ON o.user_id = e.user_id AND o.origin_kind = e.origin_kind AND o.origin_id = e.origin_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.event_id IN #{id}
SELECT * FROM learning_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND event_id IN #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM courses WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT user_id, course_id FROM user_contexts WHERE context_id = #{originId}
SELECT user_id, course_id FROM course_scope_exclusions WHERE exclusion_id = #{originId}
SELECT user_id, course_id FROM topic_class_progress WHERE progress_id = #{originId}
SELECT user_id, course_id FROM material_links WHERE link_id = #{originId}
SELECT user_id, course_id FROM class_sessions WHERE session_id = #{originId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS user_id, NULL AS course_id FROM DUAL WHERE 1 = 0

mapper.select: SELECT s.section_id, s.printed_page_start, s.printed_page_end, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_links l WHERE l.material_id = s.material_id AND l.course_id = #{courseId} AND l.user_id = #{userId}) AS linked FROM material_sections s JOIN course_materials m ON m.material_id = s.material_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.section_id IN #{id}

SELECT m.material_id, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_links l WHERE l.material_id = m.material_id AND l.course_id = #{courseId} AND l.user_id = #{userId}) AS linked FROM course_materials m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.material_id IN #{id}
SELECT session_id FROM class_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND session_id IN #{id}
